summary: This implementation plan outlines the refinement of the editor UI/UX for both the Resume and Portfolio builders. It introduces high-fidelity top toolbar styling with elegant icons and responsive layout safety. It addresses device overlaps by establishing a responsive split-view strategy (sidebar form on desktop, slide-up bottom sheet on mobile). Finally, it integrates the comprehensive PortfolioFormSection as an editor tab inside the desktop left panel and as the mobile bottom sheet content.
